title: Rank Transform of an Array
description: Replace each element in an array with its rank, where rank is determined by the element's position in the sorted unique elements.
pseudocode:
1. sorted = [...new Set(arr)].sort((a,b) => a-b)
2. rankMap = new Map()
3. for(i=0; i<sorted.length; i++) rankMap.set(sorted[i], i+1)
4. result = arr.map(x => rankMap.get(x))

steps.note: Get unique elements and sort them: [40, 10, 20, 30, 10] -> [10, 20, 30, 40]
